verdict.rationale: Several of Dialpad's own API endpoints act on multiple items in one call: anonymizing a set of specified contacts (removing PII, recordings and AI data), stripping recordings and transcripts from specified calls, and blocking a list of phone numbers company-wide. These are narrow, purpose-specific multi-item operations rather than a general bulk-operations capability, and the docs do not state batch sizes or limits. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk/batch endpoints across resource types (e.g. bulk create/update of users, contacts or numbers), documented batch sizes and async job handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
